summary.text: Neal Jackson is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 78 who has served since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A pastor and business owner, he represents Moore and Randolph counties.

paragraphs.text: Jackson was born in Pinehurst, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's and a master's degree.
His career experience includes owning an insurance and financial planning firm and working as a pastor in Florida and North Carolina, including at Beulah Baptist Church in Bennett, North Carolina.
Jackson assumed office in the North Carolina House on January 1, 2023, succeeding Allen McNeill.
He advanced from the Republican primary on March 3, 2026.
The General Assembly's website lists his occupation as pastor.

In the 2025-2026 session he is senior chair of the Finance Committee, vice chair of the Energy and Public Utilities Committee and vice chair of the House Select Committee on Property Tax Reduction and Reform.
